This estate is distinguished by its status as a certified conservation forest under Fonafifo’s Payments for Environmental Services program, ensuring the protection of its rich biodiversity. The property is particularly suited for rural and adventure tourism ventures, with agricultural zones ideal for cultivating coffee and ornamental plants. A charming rustic home, complemented by a pool and tropical gardens, awaits thoughtful remodeling to enhance its inviting character.

Este eco lodge llave en mano se encuentra en Bajos del Toro, Alajuela, y ofrece una exclusiva combinación de hospitalidad y conservación en una reserva biológica privada de 203 hectáreas. Con diez habitaciones, restaurante y áreas comunes integradas en un entorno de bosque nuboso y selva tropical, la propiedad brinda una experiencia inmersiva en la naturaleza. Sus abundantes recursos hídricos, que incluyen ríos, nacientes y cascadas, junto a una red de senderos de aproximadamente 15 kilómetros, potencian su atractivo para observadores de aves, amantes de la vida silvestre y proyectos de bienestar o conservación.
La propiedad se distingue por su ubicación en una zona montañosa reconocida por paisajes y cascadas, a poco más de una hora del Aeropuerto Juan Santamaría, facilitando el acceso sin sacrificar la privacidad y el contacto con la naturaleza. Los espacios del lodge, con acabados en madera y piedra, se integran armoniosamente al entorno, mientras que la reserva ofrece un escenario ideal para ecoturismo, retiros especializados y actividades educativas. This turnkey eco lodge and 501-acre private biological reserve in Bajos del Toro presents a unique opportunity to own an established operational base surrounded by preserved cloud forest and rainforest. The property features 10 guest rooms, a restaurant, and inviting common areas designed to immerse visitors in the natural environment. With abundant water resources including rivers, natural springs, and waterfalls, alongside a trail network of approximately 9.3 miles, the estate fosters a strong appeal for birdwatching, wildlife observation, retreats, and conservation-focused projects within this distinguished mountain setting.
Situated in the Alajuela province’s renowned Bajos del Toro area, the lodge offers a harmonious blend of hospitality and environmental stewardship. The structures incorporate warm wood finishes and rock columns that complement the lush landscape, while the restaurant’s expansive windows provide uninterrupted views of the surrounding greenery. This property is ideally suited for wellness programming, educational travel, and low-impact tourism, all within a protected natural reserve.
